configuration_boundary.morphology: bimanual dual-arm, 16 joint DoF; each arm has waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm_roll, wrist_angle, wrist_rotate, and two coupled finger joints
configuration_boundary.joint_unit: rad for hinge joints; m for finger slide joints
configuration_boundary.model_range_facts: Finger physical rail range is 0..0.041 m and software control range is 0.002..0.037 m; arm range classes are declared in the Menagerie MJCF.

source_registry.facts: ALOHA 2 overview, duplicated left/right ViperX-derived kinematic tree, gripper equality coupling, sites, joint classes, ranges, and actuator names.
ALOHA 2 bimanual hardware identity and publication provenance.

protocol_note: The 10 mm Cartesian error cap and 0.5 s terminal dwell are human-approved Demo2 research criteria, not manufacturer performance claims.

tasks.description: Move the left ALOHA gripper reference by the specified small 3-D offset from its reset pose and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single-arm Cartesian reach using a reachable target anchored to the reset left-gripper site.
tasks.criterion_summary: Left gripper target error is at most 10 mm continuously for 0.5 s.

tasks.description: Move the right ALOHA gripper reference by the specified small 3-D offset from its reset pose and hold.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Right-arm counterpart of A01 using a target anchored to the reset right-gripper site.
tasks.criterion_summary: Right gripper target error is at most 10 mm continuously for 0.5 s.

tasks.description: Move both ALOHA gripper references by the specified paired small offsets from their reset poses and hold them together.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal synchronized two-arm primitive using reachable targets anchored to both reset gripper sites.
tasks.criterion_summary: Both gripper target errors are at most 10 mm continuously for 0.5 s.

tasks.description: Open and close both ALOHA grippers once, with the two finger pairs moving together.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal dual-hand actuation check using the equality-coupled finger joints.
tasks.criterion_summary: Each gripper slide joint shows at least 0.01 m opening and closing excursion under the Demo2 research protocol.

tasks.description: Move both ALOHA gripper references by the specified small Cartesian offset, hold, and return.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable G2-style offset-and-return effect applied to both arms.
tasks.criterion_summary: Both offsets are reached within 10 mm and both final returns remain within 10 mm for 0.5 s.
